title: An ending gathers effort for growth

captions.physics: Ending an earlier form of activity
captions.emotions: Feeling a common direction of effort

meaning: Shared closure of an earlier form for growth is emotionally answered by a sense of focused movement in a common direction.
text: Death in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions that end an earlier form or phase. The Empress in energy gives a motive to nurture development and create tangible fruits of shared attention. The Chariot in emotions adds a feeling of direction and coordinated movement. The overall tone can be actively creative: you finish one particular way of participating because you want a shared undertaking to flourish, and emotionally feel your efforts acquiring a more definite course.

For example, you finish growing seedlings in cramped temporary cups and transplant them together into permanent boxes. The old containers are emptied and the earlier stage of care ends. Wanting to give the plants more room brings your work together, and the sequence becomes absorbing. **We are ending this phase so our shared care can continue in another form.** Focus concerns the movement of the activity; it does not establish that further growth is already assured. The practical transition still leaves conditions and individual needs to consider.

A difficulty appears if the emotional lift begins to hurry the ending itself. One person notices that particular plants are not ready, while the other wants to finish everything at once. Care for development gives way to maintaining the pace. The Empress as motivation requires no constant increase in scale, and the Chariot in emotions does not make speed a measure of correctness. Death concerns a particular form ending rather than requiring every neighbouring phase to close simultaneously.
